original_context: Raul does not explore esoteric concepts.
Raul does not master arcane knowledge.
Raul does not decode ancient scripts.
Raul does not discover hidden properties.
Every alchemist either pursues transmutation or explores esoteric concepts (or both).
If Raul either interprets omens or practices divination (but not both), then he masters arcane knowledge.
If Raul pursues transmutation, then he either decodes ancient scripts or seeks knowledge (or both).
If Raul collects rare materials, then he either practices divination or studies ancient texts (but not both).
If Raul studies ancient texts, then he analyzes patterns.
If Raul investigates nature and meditates on principles, then he can discover hidden properties.
If Raul seeks knowledge, then he experiments with substances and analyzes patterns.
All alchemists either investigate nature or seek alchemical truth.
For all alchemists, if they seek alchemical truth, then they experiment with substances and pursue an understanding of reality.
conclusion: Raul does not pursue an understanding of reality.
